dict.string: StackNudge listens for your phone's Bluetooth signal to tell when you've stepped away from your Mac, if you install the Away extension.

StackNudge uses System Events to focus the correct window when you act on a notification, and, if you turn on calendar join detection, reads the open tab addresses of your browser to see whether you have joined a meeting.
StackNudge reads your calendar on this Mac to remind you before meetings and to tell you when one is added, moved or cancelled. Nothing leaves your Mac.
